about: TEMPORARY: where the old hand bindings differ from RhinoCommon (.NET) on a parity case, with the reason. Doubles as migration-guide input. Delete with the old bindings.
point3d.distanceto.unset_self: old binds ON_3dPoint::DistanceTo (opennurbs): no IsValid guard (pilot-findings #14)
viewport.getfrustum: return shape: old returns a named dict and throws on failure; RhinoCommon is (success, left, right, bottom, top, near, far) (pilot-findings #5)
construct.controlpointcurve: old CreateControlPointCurve builds a uniform clamped NURBS; RhinoCommon uses the 2023 CurveThroughPolyline-style construction -- a different curve (pilot-findings #18)
vector3d.unitize: old Unitize discards opennurbs' bool and returns None (pilot-findings #19)
nurbssurface.create.invalid: old Create skips RhinoCommon's argument check (dimension < 1, order < 2, count < order) and returns an invalid surface instead of null (pilot-findings #23)
